scope_note: These requirement IDs capture claims documented in profiles/packaging/README.md's field-mapping table — not RFC2119 normative clauses from SPECIFICATION.md the way profiles/core-dp/requirements/core-dp-requirements.json does. A pass in this harness means 'this profile's documented field usage validates against the core v0.2.0 schemas and is internally consistent,' not full LOOP conformance (see profiles/core-dp/ for that) and not PPWR regulatory compliance (see docs/governance/CLAIMS-AND-MATURITY.md). PPWR's Article 12 data-carrier implementing act remains unadopted; nothing here assumes a single packaging data-carrier format.

requirements.contract_location: profiles/packaging/README.md#field-mapping (Identifying an item as reusable/grouped packaging row)
requirements.summary: A ProductDNA record whose passport.supported_regimes includes "ppwr" identifies itself as reusable/grouped packaging, so product_category must be packaging-reusable.
requirements.rationale: profiles/packaging/README.md's field-mapping table maps this PPWR need directly to product_category: packaging-reusable — the only ProductDNA category built for this. MaterialDNA packaging-waste-stream records (e.g. cardboard, plastic-pet) can independently carry supported_regimes: [ppwr] without this constraint; the check is scoped to ProductDNA only.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: semantic check that supported_regimes containing ppwr on a ProductDNA implies product_category=packaging-reusable; a MaterialDNA counter-example with ppwr tagging and a non-packaging category is a valid vector proving the check does not over-fire.

requirements.summary: passport.supported_regimes includes "ppwr" to mark a record as Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation-relevant.
requirements.rationale: Gives federation peers a consistent hint without implying conformance to the still-pending Article 12 data-carrier format.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: supported_regimes only accepts its five enum values.

requirements.summary: traceability.batch_id and lot_number carry reusable-packaging pool/batch tracking identifiers, e.g. a pooling-cycle id.
requirements.rationale: PPWR's reuse-rotation delegated act (due February 12, 2027) is not yet adopted, so LOOP has no dedicated rotation-count field; batch_id stands in as the pooling-cycle identifier per the profile's worked example.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: batch_id is a bounded-length string field on both ProductDNA and Transfer.

requirements.summary: passport.passport_id, passport_url, and data_carrier_id carry a node-chosen interim identifier scheme, not a claim of conformance with the still-pending Art. 12 format.
requirements.rationale: There is currently no regulation-defined packaging data carrier to map to; LOOP does not prescribe a scheme.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: schema-shape checks on passport_id/passport_url/data_carrier_id field types, formats, and length limits.

requirements.contract_location: profiles/packaging/README.md#field-mapping (Economic operator identity row; Document evidence row)
requirements.summary: passport.economic_operator_id/economic_operator_name and conformity_claims[] carry economic-operator identity and conformity/compliance document evidence.
requirements.rationale: PPWR's own EPR registers (Art. 44-47) are national, not EU-wide, so an economic_operator_id value is only as resolvable as the national register a receiving node has access to.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: schema-shape checks on economic_operator_id/economic_operator_name length limits and conformity_claims[] required claim_id.

requirements.summary: MaterialDNA.classification.ewc_code and waste_framework_code classify packaging waste material at end of life, independent of the ProductDNA packaging-reusable mapping.
requirements.rationale: Packaging waste commonly falls under List of Waste chapter 15 — see docs/category-classification-mapping.md. This is a MaterialDNA concept, distinct from PACKAGING-REQ-CATEGORY-MAPPING's ProductDNA scope.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: ewc_code pattern validation on a MaterialDNA record tagged with supported_regimes: [ppwr].
